visual_identity.core_identity: A predatory shapechanger disguised as a dungeon door, betrayed by a hidden eye, tongue-like handle, and organic warping in the wood.
visual_identity.silhouette: Mostly rectangular door silhouette fixed in a wall opening, with subtle bulging organic deformation.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate head; one concealed eye and a mouth or tongue integrated into door hardware or panel seams.
visual_identity.body_shape: Door slab and frame retain architectural structure while selected panels flex like living tissue.
visual_identity.surface: Simple wood panels and iron fittings with sparse organic seams.

accuracy_checks: mimic does not become unrelated monster

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
